name: dojo-verify
description: "Done" means a check ran and passed in this session. Flags claims of success with no evidence behind them.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What the Stop hook does when the final message claims success and no check has passed since the last change: block (default), warn, or off. The mod also goes inert when this is off.

show_status.title: Show status (mod)
show_status.description: Mod only: show the UNVERIFIED flag and the dispatched / returned / failed agent count in the status line. Needs function hooks enabled.

toast_unverified.title: Toast on UNVERIFIED (mod)
toast_unverified.description: Mod only: show a toast when a final answer claims success with no passing check. Needs function hooks enabled.
